events.details: medium confidence · Checks two input bytes, the context selector-0x13 status, and a computed slot value. When the slot value is within the observed 0..0x1d range, it sets byte +0x108 at the computed entry address. Indexed callers include dispatch_attribute_context_entry_processing and build_context_ranked_entry_table, supporting the conservative context-entry table wording without asserting field types (decompiled/main/main_0049.c:45987-46024; callers decompiled/main/main_0054.c:41990-41994, 42064-42068).

medium confidence · Returns the sentinel -2 when the object byte at +0x42a is clear or context selector 0x13 reports status 6 or 7. Otherwise it returns input values 0, 1, or 2 unchanged and maps larger positive values to 3; negative inputs return -2. The indexed caller passes a context object and index and consumes the result in a status-processing path (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:14011-14049; caller decompiled/main/main_0113.c:33782-33785).

medium confidence · Sets byte +0x221 on the input record, queries context selector 0x13, then checks a global context pointer through helper predicates. When the checks pass, it sets byte +0x222. Its indexed caller tail-calls it from the same record-processing path, but does not establish more specific meanings for the two flags (decompiled/main/main_0073.c:21203-21238; caller decompiled/main/main_0073.c:8888-8891).

medium confidence · Calls f_70008bbc30 with the input record and a local status output, and proceeds only when it returns true. It updates record fields at +0x254, +0x258, and +0x25c using context/global helpers, then calls the established populate_nested_player_attribute_block helper with the record, selected nested block, and status byte. The exact meanings of the selector and fields are not known, so the name stays at the visible conditional helper flow (decompiled/main/main_0111.c:11861-11889).

medium confidence · Initializes the caller-provided 32-bit output to 0xffffffff, then queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13. Statuses 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, or 5 reach f_7001812550 with 0xffff arguments; its low 16-bit result is sign-extended and stored to the output. Other statuses leave the output at -1. The helper result domain is not established, so the name describes only the observed gated signed-result store (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:6118-6156).

medium confidence · After context and predicate checks, reads 16-bit values at the resolved record+0x98 and candidate+0x360. If they match, it calls the established ranked_player_attribute_entries_rebuild helper; otherwise it returns without rebuilding (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:6006-6051). Callers include process_attribute_record_candidate_values (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:5922-5926) and a separate record update path (decompiled/main/main_0054.c:50158-50162).

low confidence · Returns 0xfffffffe unless the byte at input+0x42a is nonzero and successive attribute_context_status_value_get(selector 0x13) calls return 6 then 7. On that path, maps the second argument to itself when it is 0, 1, or 2, to 3 when it is greater than 2, and to 0xfffffffe when it is negative (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37666-37712). Indexed callers store the result into a record field (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7806-7810, 8194-8198; decompiled/main/main_0112.c:26666-26670, 27437-27441).

low confidence · The routine requires attribute_context_status_value_get(selector 0) to return 8. It then checks a helper-produced context pointer; if present, selector 0x13 must also return nonzero. The final result is true only when the low byte of the value returned by f_7001826310 is below 2; otherwise it is false (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:35610-35656). The context object and byte meaning are unresolved. Caller f_7000ab294c returns this result masked to one bit, while a caller in main_0086 branches on the result (decompiled/main/main_0076.c:16992-17000; decompiled/main/main_0086.c:38055-38066).

low confidence · Reads a 16-bit entry bound at input+0xd46a and returns false when the value exceeds 0x12b. For in-range values it returns true when attribute_context_status_value_get reports a nonzero value for selector 0x24 or 0x26; otherwise it calls f_7000780454 on input + index*0xa8 + 0x488 and negates that result (decompiled/main/main_0083.c:16906-16950). No indexed callers or semantic record evidence were available.

medium confidence · Reads a signed 16-bit field at resolved record +0x9a and stores it through the caller-provided output pointer. It queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13; only when the returned status equals 4 and an alternate record resolves does it replace the output with that record’s +0x9a value. No indexed callers are available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:1008-1041; status helper decompiled/main/main_0124.c:1023-1028).

medium confidence · Returns a boolean after checking a state byte at a resolved object +0x22, validating a nested attribute provider via validate_nested_attribute_provider, resolving nested provider data, and checking its final byte at +0x126. The indexed caller is format_pitching_substitution_prompt and branches on the returned boolean for each candidate in the prompt sequence (decompiled/main/main_0105.c:44950-44994; caller decompiled/main/main_0108.c:34464-34468, 34538-34542, 34682-34686, 35485-35489).

medium confidence · Checks the record byte at +0x5a8 and calls context_status_id_0x48_is_positive. When that predicate is false, it stores 0x400 at +0x584, conditionally copies +0x28 to +0x8, and clears byte +0x5a9; it then invokes a record helper and dispatches through the callback pointer at record +0x38, setting +0x5a9 when dispatch returns true. The name is limited to these visible updates and callback dispatch (decompiled/main/main_0031.c:6746-6778).

low confidence · Returns false unless the input byte at +0x3c9 is nonzero, then requires a sequence of helper checks to succeed, including a lookup through global address 0x7004650998, a helper with mode 4, and attribute_context_status_value_get selector 1 before calling a final record helper. Its two indexed callers branch on the boolean result; exact object/domain meaning is unresolved (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:16699-16743; callers decompiled/main/main_0056.c:16601-16602 and 17010-17011).

medium confidence · Initializes the caller output to -1, follows a global mapping entry, reads a float at input-record +0x70, transforms its sign/exponent bits into a mapping index, obtains a nested attribute base, calls nested_attribute_value_or_zero with the supplied selector, converts that float result to signed int, and stores it to the output. No indexed callers are available; this name describes the visible lookup path without assigning field semantics (decompiled/main/main_0052.c:43507-43545; nested helper decompiled/main/main_0171.c:1253-1290).

medium confidence · When the flag in the second argument is clear, the function loads the float at input+0x18 directly into the result vector and returns. When set, it reads a global configuration value; a missing value selects 1.0, otherwise it calls the helper, then musttail forwards the value and fixed remap parameters to linear_remap_clamped (decompiled/main/main_0029.c:17980-18005). Callers pass the flag/value pair as part of a larger chain of remapping helpers (decompiled/main/main_0148.c:14084-14088). The name describes the two observed paths without assigning the configuration a game-level meaning.

medium confidence · For a non-null input, the function checks nested selector 0x2b first and returns code 1 when its value is positive; if that test fails, it checks selector 0x32 and returns code 0 when positive, otherwise code 2. Missing nested entries use the provider fallback helper. Null input returns code 2 (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:11518-11557). Its indexed caller stores the returned code into a record field (decompiled/main/main_0115.c:6522-6528). No broader domain meaning is established.

medium confidence · The body initializes record fields, derives a sample coordinate, and on the positive path loads a flight segment, calls sampled_flight_segment_interpolate, then stores the interpolated values at record offsets +0x54, +0x58, and +0x5c (decompiled/main/main_0008.c:34151-34191). The indexed caller is evaluate_catch_loco_working_ring_position and calls this helper while building its position data (decompiled/main/main_0009.c:37929-37934). The name stays at the visible interpolation operation.

medium confidence · The function obtains two nested-attribute provider entries through the global context path, requests selector 0x1b from each with nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts each result to signed 32-bit integer, and accumulates them at the caller-provided output pointer (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:26892-26926). No indexed callers are available; the name describes the visible data flow without assigning a domain to selector 0x1b.

medium confidence · When the input flag bit is clear, returns the float at input+0x1c. When set, loads a global mapping value (or uses 1.0 when absent), passes it through the linear_remap_clamped helper with fixed parameters, and returns the computed float after a low-bit selection. The numeric domain is unclear, so the label describes only the observed mapping path (decompiled/main/main_0029.c:18008-18050; indexed callers decompiled/main/main_0094.c:15094-15098 and decompiled/main/main_0149.c:14092-14096).

medium confidence · Returns 2 for a null input or when neither nested-provider value is positive; returns 1 when selector 0x2b is positive, otherwise returns 0 when selector 0x32 is positive. It obtains missing provider state through f_700183f6e4 and uses nested_attribute_provider_get_float. Its indexed caller stores the classification result (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:35414-35460; caller decompiled/main/main_0112.c:23762-23766).

medium confidence · Reads a selected 32-bit record value from a global table, then writes a boolean to the caller output. The value passes when it equals 0x1e, is in 0x20-0x22, or is in 0x81-0x82, provided context selector 0x13 is not status 6; unsupported values return false (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:35243-35288; range predicate at decompiled/main/main_0170.c:53656-53665). No indexed caller is available.

medium confidence · Rounds/scales the input vector float, stores its signed 16-bit conversion at the nested record pointer+0x14, and for positive input prepares the segment interpolation call and writes three float outputs at owner offsets +0x48,+0x4c,+0x50. It calls sampled_flight_segment_interpolate; an indexed caller is evaluate_catch_loco_working_ring_position, while other callers show the helper is shared (decompiled/main/main_0008.c:34096-34142; decompiled/main/main_0009.c:37927-37931).

medium confidence · Initializes the caller output, resolves the nested context through the global entry at 0x700227f000+0x620, obtains selector 0x1d via nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts it to a signed integer, stores the first value, then resolves a second provider and adds its selector-0x1d integer value. No indexed caller is available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:24890-24927).

medium confidence · Returns -2 when the object flag at +0x42a is clear or when attribute-context selector 0x13 reports status 6 or 7. For allowed statuses, it returns 1 for the input value above 99, 0 for values 1 through 99, and -2 for nonpositive values (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37730-37776; status helper decompiled/main/main_0093.c:48967-49067). The indexed caller passes the input value at decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7814-7818 in f_7000f832a0.

medium confidence · Queries aggregate_related_attribute_values with selector 0x28 and arguments 2,0,0 using the primary context; if that result is positive it writes 1 to the caller output. Otherwise it repeats the same aggregate query using a second context and writes whether that result is positive (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:8320-8353; aggregate helper decompiled/main/main_0170.c:56000-56156). Indexed callers pass the output pointer and source object at decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7814-7818 in caller f_7000f832a0; no higher-level meaning is established.

medium confidence · Initializes a local context value, requires the first helper check and context_status_id_0x48_is_positive to pass, bounds the selector to 0..0x22, and tests its bit against two masks. Depending on those mask and helper predicates, it invokes one of two helpers that dispatch through object callbacks at offsets +0x58 or +0x60; otherwise it returns through the fallback helper (decompiled/main/main_0092.c:33723-33760; status helper decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33897-33909; callback dispatch helpers main_0092.c:29772-29798). No indexed callers are available.

medium confidence · Saves the caller output pointer, reads the global context entry, and performs two separate nested-attribute lookups with selector 0x1c. Each lookup calls nested_attribute_provider_get_float and converts the float result to a signed integer; the first is stored and the second is added to it before return (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:24842-24876; helper decompiled/main/main_0170.c:13026-13045). No indexed callers are available.

medium confidence · After context status selector 4 passes the status threshold and the global context pointer is absent, returns early when the object flag at the nested +0x5c8 path is set. Otherwise clamps the two 32-bit values at nested offsets +0x590 and +0x594 to 0x17, increments/normalizes their relationship, and stores them back (decompiled/main/main_0073.c:21157-21191). Its indexed caller at main_0073.c:8819 tail-calls this helper in the record update path.

medium confidence · Loads the player-attribute floats for selectors 0x58 and 0x59 through player_attribute_get_float, subtracts the second result from the first, and stores the resulting 32-bit float to the caller-provided output pointer (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:38347-38365). No indexed caller is available.

medium confidence · Reads the two player-attribute values using selectors 0x2d and 0x28 via player_attribute_get_float, converts each returned float to signed integer, then writes the first integer to the caller output and adds the second to it (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:22674-22708). No indexed caller is available.

low confidence · The function queries context status selector 0x45, checks the associated value/category helpers, and on the accepted branches retrieves a global object pointer and clears a 64-bit field at +0 and a 32-bit field at +8; other branches return without those stores (decompiled/main/main_0057.c:52312-52358; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:36872-36888; decompiled/main/main_0169.c:38585-38600). The indexed caller invokes this helper after checking context status id 9 (decompiled/main/main_0086.c:37217-37226). The purpose of the cleared object is not established.

medium confidence · The function follows global pointers to a context object, calls the established format_player_attribute_value_line helper with that object, obtains the selected descriptor using the input index, resolves an indexed record from global tables, and passes that record and descriptor to a follow-up lookup helper (decompiled/main/main_0121.c:32947-32972; decompiled/main/main_0108.c:38634; decompiled/main/main_0108.c:38917-38925; decompiled/main/main_0169.c:30931-30945; decompiled/main/main_0170.c:31371-31405). No indexed caller is available; the name describes the supported formatting path without assigning selector or field semantics.

medium confidence · After the object field at +0xc wraps when incremented, the function checks context status id 0x48; when positive it tail-calls f_7000243bb8 with mode 1. Otherwise it checks the object at +8, then chooses mode 1 only when +0x10 equals 7 and mode 0 otherwise (decompiled/main/main_0017.c:40646-40690). The caller supplies an object loaded from +0x31b8 after a separate status-0x18 check (decompiled/main/main_0013.c:18135-18141). The exact record domain is unclear, so the label only describes the observed gates and dispatch.

medium confidence · For the input value, the function obtains descriptor bytes through the lookup helpers and selects one of two base-minus-descriptor results: 0xa3 for values at or above 0x23, or 0x97 only for a value accepted by attribute_context_category_in_range and mapped to class 2; otherwise it returns 0 (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:52318-52329, 52334-52355; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:29348-29364, 30227-30246; decompiled/main/main_0169.c:53406-53412, 53670-53677). Its caller iterates entries, passes the +0xc value here, then forwards the result to a context table helper (decompiled/main/main_0049.c:42513-42525). The identifier domain is not established, so the name stays generic.

medium confidence · Returns 2 for a null provider; otherwise reads nested provider float selector 0x2b and returns 1 if it is positive. If it is not positive, reads selector 0x32 and returns 0 when that is positive or 2 otherwise (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:11492-11527). Two callers store the returned category in adjacent record slots (decompiled/main/main_0117.c:30053-30055; decompiled/main/main_0118.c:6481-6483).

medium confidence · Reads attribute context selector 4, dispatches through the context object at +0xc0, returns -2 when the selector-4 status is outside 3..9, and otherwise classifies the dispatch result into 0, 1, or 2 using the status-derived thresholds (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:23001-23023, 23025-23039). Its caller stores the returned category for further processing (decompiled/main/main_0117.c:31528-31530).

medium confidence · Iterates indices up to the global entry count at +0x40, obtains each entry through f_700181a8cc, checks the signed 16-bit value at entry+0x152 with attribute_context_value_is_supported, and when unsupported increments byte counters at entry+0x19d and entry+0x19e (decompiled/main/main_0058.c:28115-28146). No indexed callers were available; the name describes only the visible entry and counter behavior.

medium confidence · Returns 1 immediately when the input object already has a non-null pointer at +0x918. Otherwise it clears the pointed byte, allocates 0x2c0 bytes, constructs the owned resource, installs it at +0x918, and initializes its nested record. The indexed caller is initialize_player_roster_asset_records, supporting this conservative role name (decompiled/main/main_0164.c:36300-36342; caller decompiled/main/main_0164.c:21672-21676).

Indexed callers store this result into their output records (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:14127-14172; caller decompiled/main/main_0117.c:14540-14544; caller decompiled/main/main_0119.c:2389-2394).

Its indexed caller process_milb_player_xp routes event 0x29b here and returns the result (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:21775-21820; caller decompiled/main/main_0113.c:50581-50586, 50648-50651).

No indexed callers are available; the name describes the guarded formatting flow without assigning an attribute domain (decompiled/main/main_0125.c:28793-28837; formatter behavior decompiled/main/main_0108.c:38634).
